look.whale: enormous, the greatest of all that swim, shaped like the leaping grey one but vast
look.cow: large and heavy, four legs, a patched hide, horns, a deep lowing voice
look.pig: pink, stout, a flat snout, grunts, roots in the ground
look.sheep: round and woolly, four thin legs, bleats, eats the grass
look.horse: tall and swift, long legs, a mane and a long tail
look.donkey: stocky and sure-footed, grey-brown, with very long ears and a loud braying voice
look.mule: strong and patient, bigger than the long-eared one but with a tall swift beast's build, with long ears and a harsh voice, and it has no young
look.goat: sure-footed, horned, thick-coated, leaps on steep rock and sometimes lowers its head to charge
look.chicken: a small bird that walks more than it flies, clucks, pecks at seeds
look.parrot: a bright bird of many colours that flies and copies sounds
look.bat: a tiny dark winged creature of dusk and gloom, with no feathers, that flutters in jerks and squeaks
look.rabbit: small, long ears, hops, very quick
look.frog: small, wet skin, leaps, croaks, a long tongue
look.turtle: carries a round shell on its back, slow on land, graceful in water
look.armadillo: small, covered in hard plates, rolls into a ball
look.bee: tiny, striped, hums, goes from flower to flower
look.llama: tall with a long woolly neck, proud, sometimes spits
look.camel: very tall, a hump on its back, long legs, kneels to rest
look.wolf: lean and grey-furred, long-legged, with a sharp muzzle and upright ears, hunts in packs, howls
look.fox: small and quick, rust-red or white, with a thick bushy tail, pointed ears and a sharp face, sleeps curled up by day
look.cat: small and soft-pawed, with a long tail and bright eyes, walks silently, purrs, and sits and watches
look.ocelot: a lean spotted hunter of the dense hot forest, yellow with dark markings, shy and quick, creeping low among the leaves
look.panda: big, round, black and white, sits and eats, rolls over
look.polar_bear: huge, thick-furred and white, heavy-pawed, at home in ice and cold water, gentle unless its young are threatened
look.cod: a plain brown fish that swims in shoals
look.salmon: a long red-sided fish, strong, leaps
look.tropical_fish: a small fish in bright colours and patterns
look.pufferfish: a small round fish that swells into a prickly ball when something comes near
look.squid: soft, dark, many arms, squirts black ink
look.glow_squid: like the soft many-armed ink-squirter, but it glows blue-green in the dark water
look.dolphin: sleek and grey, leaps out of the water, clicks and whistles, playful
look.nautilus: a swimmer in a great coiled shell, with trailing arms
look.axolotl: a small smiling water creature with a flat face, four stubby legs, a flat tail and feathery gills like branches at the sides of its head
look.tadpole: a tiny dark swimming speck with a wriggling tail, that will one day grow legs

the great mountain.look: A huge mountain with a white crown of snow, taller than anything else, with a thin stream running down its near face.

the still water.look: A wide quiet lake in the middle of the land, so still that the sky lies in it.

the cold spring.look: High on the mountain, where water first comes out of the cold stone and begins its long run down to the lake.

the place of waking.look: A smooth clearing of short grass a little above the sand, with the whole land opening out ahead.

the pale shore.look: A long gentle shore of pale sand where the sea comes and goes and the whales sing beyond.

the white spires.look: Tall thin towers of white ice rise out of a flat white plain like the teeth of some great animal.

the red stone country.look: Flat-topped hills of red and orange and yellow stone, striped in layers, with almost nothing growing on them.

the sea of sand.look: A wide land of pale sand without a single stream, heaped by the wind into long soft ridges.

the tall dry grass.look: Open ground of yellow grass as high as a knee, with a few flat-topped trees standing far apart.

the warm marsh.look: Low wet ground and still brown water, with heavy dark trees hung with trailing vines.

the roots that walk in water.look: Trees standing on high tangled roots in shallow muddy water close to the sea.

the green tangle.look: A hot, steaming forest of huge trees wound about with creepers, so thick that the ground is always in shade.

the singing canes.look: Straight green stalks as thick as a wrist and taller than any tree, creaking softly as they lean together.

the pink grove.look: Gentle hills covered in trees whose leaves are pink, and petals drift down like snow.

the dark wood.look: A crowded forest of huge dark trees whose tops close out the sky, so that it is dim even at noon.

the pale wood.look: A quiet grey-white forest where the trees look bleached and the air is still and strange.

the field of gold.look: A wide plain full of tall yellow flowers that all turn their faces toward the sun.

the old giants.look: Enormous dark evergreen trees as old as the hills, with moss and ferns beneath them.

the island of strange caps.look: A small island far from shore where huge soft caps, red and brown, grow instead of trees.

the grey heights.look: Bare grey hills of loose stones where the wind blows hard and little grows.

the snow roof.look: The highest white ground, ice and snow all around, where the air is thin and bitterly cold.

the singing shore.look: A coast of grey boulders and cliffs where the sea breaks loudly.

the long river.look: A clear river that begins in the mountains and winds a long way down, falling a step at a time, to the sea.

the high pool.look: A small round lake high in the hills, cold and clear, with the sky and the stones upside down in it.

the dark mouth.look: A black opening in the hillside, cool air breathing out of it, leading down into the rock.

the clearing.look: the flat ground where you both first opened your eyes

the meadow.look: the wide open grass between the clearing and the lake, where the creatures graze

the lake.look: a wide still water in the middle of the land, ahead of where you woke; lilies float on it and reeds grow at its edge

the near shore.look: behind where you woke, where the land ends in pale sand and the great water begins
